title: ConformalGoCo (GoCo): co-essentiality-guided conformal calibration for Gene Ontology annotation release
description: Reference implementation, frozen analysis-ready inputs and complete split-level results for GoCo, a calibration and release layer that certifies a gene-level false discovery proportion for predicted Gene Ontology annotations without retraining the upstream predictor. Includes the Wainberg co-essentiality development analysis and independent validation on Sanger Project Score, Project DRIVE and a HAP1 genetic-interaction network, together with the scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the paper and the ranking-fold measurability test.
